defects.title: Unit test pollution from persistent on-disk settings.json
defects.root_cause: RuntimeState.__init__ unconditionally loads settings.json from project root, coupling test suite outcomes to user runtime settings.
defects.impact: test_wakanda_gesture fails when settings.json has 'wakanda-forever': true on developer machines.
defects.remediation: Add dependency injection for settings_path or support AIRPOINT_SETTINGS_PATH override; test runner defaults to isolated in-memory or fixture settings. Verified passing 224/224 tests.

defects.title: Unauthenticated local HTTP bridge and broad localhost origin acceptance
defects.root_cause: ControlRequestHandler allows requests from any localhost/127.0.0.1 port without an authentication secret or CSRF token, and allows requests with missing Origin headers.
defects.impact: Malicious webpages running in any browser on localhost can trigger /api/toggle or change gesture settings.
defects.remediation: Issue ephemeral 32-byte session token on startup, write to .bridge_token and bridge_info.json, enforce strict Origin whitelist and require X-AirPoint-Token header on mutating endpoints.

defects.title: Potential stuck left mouse down on abrupt tracking loss during drag
defects.root_cause: If tracking drops abruptly while is_dragging == True, drag_end() is only called on engine pause or left hand state transition; frame loss may leave mouse button down.
defects.impact: Windows cursor remains locked in dragging mode on the user's desktop until hand is re-acquired.
defects.remediation: Implemented actuator watchdog check_drag_watchdog that releases left mouse button if is_dragging is True without keep-alive touch for > 0.25s, and guaranteed immediate release on process(None) and reset().

defects.title: Silent fallback to ephemeral port breaks frontend connectivity
defects.root_cause: When port 8765 is occupied, ControlServer binds to port 0 (ephemeral), but the frontend hardcodes 8765 without a discovery mechanism.
defects.impact: User sees permanent 'Engine offline' in Control Center with no error message explaining port collision.
defects.remediation: Fail deterministically with actionable diagnostic RuntimeError on occupied port with clear guidance to resolve PID conflict; write active port and token to bridge_info.json and .bridge_token on startup.

defects.title: Hand self-occlusion degrades FaceMesh confidence during ear/lip touch
defects.root_cause: Hand approaching ear (#234, #454) or lips (#13, #14) obscures face contour, causing FaceMesh confidence to drop below threshold.
defects.impact: Intermittent frame drops during ear contact or lip touch can prematurely reset hold timers.
defects.remediation: Introduce temporal landmark smoothing and a 0.35s face anchor memory buffer when hand is detected within proximity threshold.

defects.title: Redundant JPEG encoding and frame copies in HTTP MJPEG camera streaming
defects.root_cause: Frames are resized and re-encoded to JPEG inside the streaming generator loop for every active client instead of once globally.
defects.impact: Increases CPU utilization and can throttle tracking loop FPS on low-power devices.
defects.remediation: Cache the latest JPEG frame globally with a timestamp or frame-id check so multiple consumers share one encoded buffer.

defects.title: Unbounded EventSource reconnect loop when Python bridge is offline
defects.root_cause: Native EventSource reconnects continuously every 3s even when /api/status confirms bridge is offline.
defects.impact: Noisy browser console error logs during standalone frontend development or when engine is stopped.
defects.remediation: Only initialize EventSource once connected === true is established by status heartbeat.

defects.title: Windows mouse acceleration remains disabled if engine is terminated via SIGKILL
defects.root_cause: SPI_SETMOUSE acceleration bypass relies on graceful exit handlers (finally / atexit); force kill bypasses restoration.
defects.impact: User's pointer speed feel altered after sudden crash or Task Manager kill.
defects.remediation: Provide restore_mouse.bat script and document restoration procedure.
